payload.report: This 3-month-old infant had nasal obstruction, failure to thrive, craniosynostosis, frontal bossing, and limb abnormalities. Examination showed membranous choanal atresia with perforations; 3D CT excluded bony atresia. A de novo USP9X mutation explains the multisystem phenotype and directly supports USP9X-related syndromic choanal atresia. Isolated and acquired causes are excluded by syndromic features, congenital findings, and genetic evidence. Alternative causes are unlikely. Frontier sufficient.
